title: 关于飞升
text: Ascendancies are a new way to develop your character in a more specified direction. These sub classes are available to any class and expand the possibility of builds greatly.
There are 14 ascendancies implemented at the moment.

title: 如何飞升
text: After defeating Baal for the first time in normal difficulty, he will drop Ascendancy Cairn alongside Ascendancy Soulstone of Tier 1 - Soulstone of Might.

To cycle through the available Ascendancies, just cube Soulstone of Might on its own. After you have decided which Ascendancy you want to advance with, cube Soulstone of Might with your Ascendancy Cairn. Ascendancy Cairn acts as any other talisman, so just keep it in your inventory.

Defeating Baal for the first time on Nightmare and Hell difficulties, will yield you Soulstones of Tier 2 and 3 respectively. Cube them with your Ascendancy Cairn to unlock more power of the sub-class of your choice.
To obtain final Soulstone and achieve complete ascension, you have to prove your strength by defeating any of the Ubers on any tier:

title: 如何重置
text: In order to respec, cube your Ascendancy Cairn with Token of Absolution. This will scour it and give you back all hard earned ascendancy stones.

title: 血法师
text: - Gain 1% elemental and magic mastery for every 40 life
- Heal for 1% of Maximum Life on Kill

title: 时空法师
text: - +1 to Time Warp (Additional temporal movement/attack speed/faster cast rate bonus)
- +1 to Time Freeze (All speeds debuff for enemy; Curse)

title: 主宰
text: - 25% chance to cast Endurance Charge on being hit
- Every endurance charge gives 2% Physical Damage Duration
- Every endurance charge gives 5% Elemental Resistance
- Gain Attack Rating equal to double your strength
- Gain 1% Increased Attack Speed per 40 Attack Rating
- Gain 25% Enhanced Damage per Endurance Charge

title: 圣职者
text: - 30% Damage Taken Gained as Mana when Hit
- 25% chance to cast Level 1 Arcane Surge on casting
- Gain Faster Cast Rate equal to 1% of your maximum mana
- Gain Fire, Cold, Lightning equal to 2% of your maximum mana
- Gain Skill Area of Effect equal to 1% of your maximum mana

title: 狂战士
text: - Gain 4 to 10 Physical Damage to melee attacks per 1% Life stolen per hit

title: 元素师
text: - 25% chance to cast Level 1 Mastermind of Discord on casting:
- Gives +30% to Fire, Cold and Lightning masteries
- Gives -15% to Fire, Cold and Lightning Enemy Resistances
- Gain 1 Mana per 1% of Fire Mastery
- Gain 2% Mana Recovery per 1% of Cold Mastery
- Gain 1% Faster Cast Rate per 10% of Lightning Mastery

title: 秘术师
text: - You may apply an additional Curse
- 15% chance to cast Level 1 Profane Bloom on kill
- Profane Bloom deals 4000 magic damage in 10yd radius
- Gain +10% Curse Effect per curse you can apply
- Gain +1% Magic Mastery per 1% Curse Effect
- Gain +1% Faster Hit Recovery per 1% Curse Effect

title: 守护者
text: - Increases strength, dexterity and energy by 20%
- Gain 1% to Aura Effect per every 2% to Maximum of any elemental resistance
- Gain 100 base defence per 4% of Aura Effect

title: 巫妖
text: - You May Summon 3 Additional Skeleton Warriors
- You May Summon 6 Additional Skeleton Mages
- You May Summon 4 Additional Skeleton Archers
- Your minions gain 30% More Maximum Life
- Level 1 Commander of Darkness aura when equipped
- Commander of Darkness grants +75% Enhanced Defense to your minions
- Commander of Darkness grants +150% Enhanced Damage to your minions
- Commander of Darkness grants 5% Life Steal to your minions
- Above values scale with Aura Effect

title: 寻路者
text: - Each Wither stack provides -2% to Enemy Poison Resistance
- Wither is refreshed with each stack
- 25% chance to gain +50% poison mastery on striking
- 35% chance to gain +50% poison mastery on casting

title: 灵行者
text: - You may summon 3 additional Spirit Wolves
- Your minions gain "Physical Damage Taken Reduced by" equal to 25% of yours

title: 锐眼
text: - 50% chance to gain 1 Gale Force on Striking
- Gale Force also grants 10% Attack Rating per stack
- Gale Force also grants 2% Physical Damage Reduction per stack
- Gain +125% Enhanced Damage per Maximum Attack Projectile

title: 酋长
text: - Modifiers to Fire Resistance also apply to Cold, Lightning and Poison Resistances at 50% of their Value
- Modifiers to Maximum Fire Resistance also apply to Maximum Cold, Lightning and Poison Resistances
- 15% chance to cast Level 1 Explosion on kill
- Explosion deals 5000-5000 fire damage in 10yd radius

title: 破坏者
text: - You have Life regeneration equal to 5% of your Maximum Life
- Your traps gain elemental pierce and mastery at 125% value
